resolution: The user's log line '[loader] constructed map ... (no JS)' showed they were in the COMPILED game (world_loader), not /test — a different spawn path from req_0521. chooseSpawn picks the top of the nearest flat INSTANCE ROW (a floor box) near the map centre and never consults the scene's 50 painted-terrain heightfields, so on a map with painted hills the spawn sat under the terrain surface; below a heightfield's top no collider can catch a body, so the player fell through the world on every load. Fix 60f687afd (world_loader.zig): new sceneTerrainTopAt samples the highest covering heightfield at the spawn (x,z); spawn y clamps up to that surface and then drops in from SPAWN_DROP_CLEARANCE_METERS (0.35m) so an imprecise sample still settles ONTO the ground — the 'raise my spawn drop' the user asked for. zig ast-check + a full ReleaseFast loader build are green; 'rjit game play' rebuilds the loader on launch, so the user just runs it again.
